Graduated from MIEM, am studying in graduate school, work as a network administrator.

I love UNIX, Internet, WAREZ (fresh), beer (fresh, cold, Bud), beautiful girls, heavy music (melodic power metal, doom, black), Quake meat and a rocket launcher.

My character is terrible, but cute )))... I often withdraw into myself, but so far I have always returned :)

Creator and permanent admin of the clan Quake server.
